items.title: Why Robinhood Stock Is Jumping When Bitcoin, Other Crypto Plays Are Falling
items.summary: Robinhood  Markets stock has often moved with the price of Bitcoin but not today.  Shares of the mobile trading platform were up 1.7% in early trading Tuesday, even as other crypto-exposed stocks  Coinbase Global  and  Strategy  were down 4% and 6% respectively.  Bitcoin was down 0.4% to $77,564.

items.title: Crypto Stocks Slide as Bitcoin and Ethereum Hold Flat: Circle Internet and Bitmine Fall 4%, Coinbase Drops 3%
items.summary: Bitcoin and Ethereum are barely moving this Tuesday, yet the stocks built around them are crashing open sharply lower. A shock from an unexpected corner of the market explains why crypto equities are suddenly trading as if the coins themselves had collapsed.
